name: Solidarity Concert: Vida Norte
description: Enjoy a heartwarming evening of music for a great cause. This special concert supports the Vida Norte Association, which aids vulnerable mothers and babies, featuring a children's choir and special guests.
longDescription:
The Solidarity Concert: Vida Norte is a special musical event dedicated to supporting the Vida Norte Association. This organization provides essential assistance to vulnerable mothers and their babies in the Porto region. The concert features performances by a children's choir, alongside various special guest artists, presenting an evening of diverse musical acts. The initiative aims to raise funds and awareness for Vida Norte's ongoing work.

Attendees can expect an evening focused on community and charitable giving, held within the grand setting of Casa da Música. The atmosphere will be one of shared purpose, suitable for a broad audience interested in supporting local social causes. The duration of the concert will be typical for a musical performance, offering a structured program of performances.

This is a ticketed event. Casa da Música is located in Boavista and is well-served by public transport, including the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), which is directly adjacent to the venue. Several bus lines also stop nearby. The venue is designed with accessibility in mind. The concert is suitable for families.
